title: Saudi Arabian Vegan Stuffed Bell Peppers
description: A flavorful and nutritious twist on traditional stuffed peppers, inspired by Saudi Arabian cuisine and made entirely vegan.
instructions: Cut the tops off the bell peppers and remove the seeds and membranes.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the quinoa and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Stir in the tagine spice blend and vegan gouda cheese.
Stuff each bell pepper with the quinoa mixture.
Place the bell peppers in a baking dish and cover with a lid.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the bell peppers are tender.
